metadata.title: the CT scan dataset
metadata.description: A secondary dataset compiled from a partner clinic in Lisbon, the CT scan dataset includes 500 anonymized CT scans, each manually segmented by two independent radiologists. This dataset was used to explore multimodal deep learning strategies for medical image analysis in chest radiology.
